Im Haus auf <b>„Planen“</b> tippen (nur: In the house, tap "Plan" (PC only, only with the "Plan the house" permission – admins always may). <b>Etagen:</b> Reiter oben; „+“ legt Obe: Floors: tabs at the top; "+" adds an upper floor, basement, attic or outdoor area – optionally with the outer walls of the current floor. The floor below is shown dashed as a guide.
<b>Wände:</b> Werkzeug „Wand“, Punkte se: Walls: "Wall" tool, set points, type a length + Enter for exact dimensions. Or "Walls from dimensions". Upload a floor plan image, set the scale using a known distance and trace it.
<b>Türen, Fenster, Durchgänge:</b> Werkz: Doors, windows, openings: choose the tool and click on a wall; set width, height and sill height in the properties panel.
<b>Räume:</b> Werkzeug „Raum“ und in ein: Rooms: "Room" tool, click into an area enclosed by walls and give it a name. The room follows when walls are moved. Imported or open rooms have a fixed outline ("detect from walls" switches this).
<b>Möbel:</b> „Möbel“ öffnet den Katalog: Furniture: "Furniture" opens the catalogue; choose and place – cabinets snap to walls and neighbours. R rotates, Del deletes, Ctrl+D duplicates, Ctrl+Z undoes. For shelf units, cabinets and chests of drawers the number of shelves or drawers is adjustable; a custom name ("Pantry cabinet") appears in the inventory.
<b>Sperren:</b> Wände, Fenster/Türen, Mö: Locking: fix walls, windows/doors, furniture and rooms with "Lock" or L – they can then no longer be selected, moved or deleted in the editor (padlock icon in the floor plan). In the "Floor" panel → "Locked" unlock them one by one or all at once; there is also "Lock all walls". The inventory (clicking compartments, checking in) keeps working.
<b>Möbel &amp; Deko:</b> unter „Möbel“ d: Furniture & decor: under "Furniture" the "Online library" – source Poly Haven (free, real dimensions) or FurniMesh (realistic furniture, size is set to typical dimensions, loading takes about 10 s). Search works in German too; your own .glb files can be uploaded.
<b>Materialien:</b> Fronten, Arbeitsplat: Materials: fronts, worktop, floor, walls – from the library, a custom colour or an uploaded texture; individual elements and rooms (flooring) can differ.
<b>3D:</b> „Etage“, „Bis hier“ (Blick vo: 3D: "Floor", "Up to here" (view from above into the house) or "House" (all floors with roof). "Photorealistic" renders with path tracing; "Walk through": walk through the whole house like in a game with WASD and the mouse, up the stairs to other floors (Esc exits).
Der Plan wird automatisch gespeichert un: The plan is saved automatically and shared with everyone (only people with the "Plan the house" permission may change it; granted under Administration → People). If two people work on it at the same time, the app asks which version applies.

Installed furniture types appear in their group under "Furniture" when planning.
<b>Editor:</b> Name, Maße und Aufbau – S: Editor: name, dimensions and layout – columns from left to right, with elements from top to bottom inside (drawer, door with shelves, open compartment, flap, fridge or freezer compartment, washing machine, dryer), heights and widths as ratios. Optionally with a worktop (e.g. washing machine under a worktop) – also as part of the kitchen run. Or your own 3D model (.glb) with compartments defined. The preview shows each compartment as a frame – every compartment becomes a location.
Das Haus behält eine <b>Kopie</b> jeder: The house keeps a copy of every furniture type it uses: changes in the library do not change existing furniture or location codes. If there is a newer version, the furniture offers "Use version …" when planning.
<b>Teilen:</b> Exportieren speichert ein: Sharing: exporting saves a .zuhause-objekt.json that can be imported elsewhere or submitted as a pull request to the catalogue repo mupf-dev/homemgmt-object-library. Anyone with the "Plan the house" permission may change and install furniture types.

Unter <b>Mehr → Einstellungen</b> legt j: Under More → Settings each person decides for themselves: whether the app starts with the overview or the house, whether the house first appears as a floor plan (2D) or in 3D, light/dark and the font size. The settings apply on all of the person's devices.
Erreicht eine Buchung den Server nicht,: If a transaction does not reach the server, it is queued and booked automatically as soon as the connection is back. At the top, "n transactions waiting" shows the status – tap it to retry immediately. Nothing is booked twice, even if only the response got lost. Compartments and items from the house plan can be scanned without a network too. If the server rejects a queued transaction (e.g. because the item is gone by now), the app reports it individually.
Ein Tablet an der Wand zeigt das Haus zu: A tablet on the wall shows the house for searching and viewing – without a personal sign-in. Whoever checks something in or takes it out taps their tile; the choice applies for 90 seconds (shown at the top, tap to switch). When idle, the terminal returns to the house and shows the standby screen: the house dimmed, in the light of the time of day and the local weather, plus clock, shopping list and what expires soon. Tap to wake it.
Ist die <b>Lage des Hauses</b> gesetzt (: If the location of the house is set (Plan → menu ⋯ → "Location of the house": search for an address or enter coordinates, north direction), the sun in 3D is where it is outside; sky, light and weather follow live on the terminal, with a lawn around the house.
<b>Wetter und Gewitter:</b> Wolken, Rege: Weather and thunderstorms: clouds, rain, snow and fog appear as they do outside. Lightning comes in real time from Blitzortung.org: within 50 km the terminal shows a notice, and a lightning map on the standby screen; nearby strikes make the screen flash.

Am <b>Wandterminal</b> stehen die Aufgab: On the wall terminal the tasks are in the navigation on the left; tick them off via "Who is booking?". The standby screen also shows due tasks. Creating and changing tasks is done in the app.

Ein Datum je Gegenstand (beim Einbuchen: One date per item (when checking in or editing). Orange from 30 days before expiry, red afterwards; the home page warns about expiry within 7 days. "New conversation" clears the history.

Automatisch alle 24 Stunden (14 bleiben): Automatically every 24 hours (14 are kept). Administration → Backups: back up now, download, restore (the current state is backed up first) or upload. Export/import: all items as Excel or CSV; importing shows a preview first, then backs up and books.
